reason: The plugin is primarily for automating session setup by injecting always-apply skill instructions into the model-visible history, as described in the README: it hooks `agent/pre-step`, selects opt-in skills by frontmatter/summary/config, and prepends a durable instruction message. This positions it as a workflow/context automation utility within DeepSeek Harness rather than a tool for UI, search, or external service access.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在会话初始阶段自动注入标记为 `alwaysApply`（或按配置指定）的技能内容，帮助在模型可见上下文中持续生效固定指令，无需额外加载 skill 工具。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically injects configured `alwaysApply` skill content into the first model-visible session message so selected standing instructions are present from the start.

capabilities: Injects selected skill bodies into the first model-visible session message before the first model request.
Reads skill metadata from catalog summaries, loaded skill definitions, and skill-file frontmatter to determine `alwaysApply` candidates.
Provides opt-in control via `names`, `disabledNames`, `skipSubagent`, and `maxTotalBytes` before injection.
Can inject skill content even when `modelInvocable` is false, while leaving it out of a user tool call path.
